entities.name: IL23A (Q9NPF7)
observations: The 191-aa query matches reviewed human IL-23 subunit alpha Q9NPF7 at 86.9% identity and 100% coverage (E=2.07e-112).
IL23A associates with IL12B to form the secreted pro-inflammatory cytokine IL-23.
Reference annotations link IL23A to IL-23 receptor/JAK-STAT signaling, immune response, and Th17-cell expansion; localization is ER lumen and extracellular after secretion.
Query Pfam scan detects IL23 family domain PF16649.11 at residues 28–186 (i-Evalue 1.5e-94).

entities.name: IL12B
observations: IL12B associates with IL23A to form the IL-23 heterodimer, which is secreted.

entities.name: IL-23 signaling
observations: Curated reference annotations associate IL23A with IL-23-mediated signaling and cell-surface receptor signaling via JAK-STAT/STAT.
